newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: SOCCER-COSTA RICANS GIVEN GREEN LIGHT TO JOIN DERBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COSTA RICANS GIVEN GREEN LIGHT TO JOIN DERBY.

text.p: Costa Rican striker Paulo Cesar Wanchope and midfielder Mauricio Solis have been given authorisation to play for English premier league club Derby County.
"We are ready to play in English football," Wanchope said on Thursday.

Wanchope said the pair had been waiting for permission from the English Professional Footballers' Association (PFA) who were concerned that the salary being offered to the two men by Derby was below average.
The PFA were worried about the potentially damaging knock-on effect for all professional players.
Raul Chacon, secretary of the Costa Rican federation, said Derby had since agreed to increase the players' salaries.
The two players are currently training with the national team who face the United States at home in a World Cup qualifier on Sunday.
